why: Six named lines in globals.css (the current lines 6 to 9 are exactly as the brief says), a scan test on the file's own text, and docs. The before/after class-list comparison with comm is a strong check: any class lost beyond the ten named ones stops the push. Nothing touches money, auth or data.
